name: operating
description: Operating is a platform to run the operations of a consulting firm or professional services firm. This connector lets agents work directly with your Operating data.

interface.longDescription:
Operating is a platform to run the operations of a consulting firm or professional services firm. This connector lets your agent work directly with your Operating data: projects, people, allocations, time entries, budgets, expenses and invoices.
Use it to answer questions about your business and to make changes without switching tools. Resource people on projects, move allocations when plans change, log time, and update budgets and expenses directly from ChatGPT. Ask who is available next month, which projects are over budget, or how utilization looks for a team. What you can do:

- Resource planning: see availability and utilization, create and move projects and allocations, and resource people on projects
- Project creation: add projects with all their data (team, rates, budgets...) to Operating directly from ChatGPT based on SoWs, planning files, and project proposals.
- Time tracking: log time and review time entries by person, project or task.
- Project financials: review and update budgets, planned expenses and actual spend, and compare planned and actual revenue.
- Invoicing: look up invoices and their line items.
- Keep competence and project data up-to-date: update people's skills based on project history, and easily keep project metadata up-to-date
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me work with Operating using its connected tools.

positive.prompt: Find a project starting in the next 30 days with unfilled resource requirements. Identify team members with available capacity during the project dates and present their availability for comparison. Create a tentative 50% allocation on the planning timeline for a suitable team member, clearly marked as a draft for the manager to review and adjust. This is a hypothetical resource planning scenario, not a confirmed assignment or employment decision.
positive.expected_behavior: A short list of team members and their available capacity during the project dates, followed by a draft allocation on the planning timeline showing the person, project, role, dates, and percentage. Clearly indicate that the allocation is tentative and can be reviewed, modified, or removed by the manager before being finalized.

positive.prompt: Log 2 hours today on one of the projects I'm assigned to with the note 'Test entry'.
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of this week's time entries by day and project, followed by confirmation of the new 2-hour entry with the project name, date and note.

positive.prompt: Show revenue, cost and margin for our active projects last month, and compare logged hours to planned hours. Flag any project running over budget.
positive.expected_behavior: A per-project breakdown of revenue, cost, margin, and planned versus actual hours for last quarter, with over-budget projects clearly flagged.

positive.prompt: What's our team's planned utilization for the next four weeks? Who has the most free capacity and who is overbooked?
positive.expected_behavior: Planned utilization per person for the next four weeks, with the people who have the most free capacity and anyone booked over 100% called out.

positive.prompt: List the skills most commonly assigned to our people and give an analysis of our competence stack.
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked list of the most common skills with how many people hold each one and at what level, followed by a short analysis of the team's strengths, thin areas where only one or two people hold a skill, and any gaps worth addressing.

negative.description: A general industry question that doesn't need the user's own data.
negative.prompt: What's a good utilization rate target for a consulting firm?

negative.description: This is calendar scheduling. Operating plans people's time on projects but doesn't book meetings.
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team next Tuesday at 10am.

negative.description: The user wants a blank template to fill in, not a report from their Operating data.
negative.prompt: Build me a spreadsheet template for calculating project margins.
